sources.method: Editorial staff list, kept from the previous pass. Critic source: used only to break exact ties, and no tie needed it, so it is not in the averages.

changes_vs_current: Re-ranked on 9 people sources (was 4 with IGN in the math). IGN 2011 is now kind 'critic' (tie-break only; no tie needed it). New people sources: Casino.org 2023 US survey, YouGov 2018 Stan Lee characters (Marvel-only, so absent DC heroes are skipped, not penalised), Morning Consult 2021 MCU character favorability (MCU-only, skipped the same way), Wisevoter 2022, Box Office Mojo domestic gross of solo films, and Wikipedia pageviews. Moves: Superman #1->#3 and Spider-Man #3->#1 (Spider-Man is #1-3 in all 9 sources and #1 in 5; Superman #1 in only 2). Batman stays #2. Iron Man #7->#4 (OnePoll 5, YouGov 3, MC 2, Wisevoter 4, Vue 6, pageviews 5). Wolverine #6->#5 (YouGov #2 at 10%, Casino tied #3-5, Vue 7, box office 5 once Deadpool & Wolverine counts). It averages 6.69, behind Iron Man at 5.78, so the data do not support Jordan's #4 for Wolverine and #6 for Iron Man: Iron Man is higher in OnePoll, Wisevoter, Vue, MC and pageviews. Captain America #5->#6, Wonder Woman #4->#7 (weak box office 14 and pageviews 13; WW is still #4-6 in the polls). Hulk #9->#8. Black Panther #18->#9 (MC 6, YouGov 6, OnePoll 9, box office 6; the old rank came from IGN's #51). Deadpool #15->#10 (box office 4). Thor #10->#11. Doctor Strange #19->#12. Captain Marvel #8->#13 (only OnePoll #8 is strong; pageviews 26, box office 13). Black Widow enters at #14 (MC 8, pageviews 11). Robin #12->#15. Jean Grey enters at #16 and The Punisher at #18, each on pageviews alone. Aquaman #22->#17. Green Lantern #13->#19. Daredevil #14->#20. The Flash #11->#21. Ghost Rider enters at #22 (Vue 20, pageviews 16). Ant-Man enters at #23 (MC 9, box office 11, YouGov 1%). Hellboy #16->#24. Out: Green Arrow (#35 in pageviews only), Cyclops (#28 avg, pageviews only), Storm (#31), Hawkeye (#29: MC 13th of 20, YouGov 1%, pageviews 30th, no solo film), Shazam (#32: box office 18, pageviews 33). Venom (#17 avg) and Catwoman were left out as mainly villains. Gut check: 11 of my 12 are in the top 11. The Flash (gut top 12) lands at #21, but the sources put him lower: Vue UK #15, box office 22nd of 23, pageviews 27th, and he is absent from OnePoll, Casino and Wisevoter. So he was not moved. Tie at 16.0: The Flash (3 sources) ahead of Ghost Rider (2).
confidence: medium. Top 3 is solid: every source puts Spider-Man, Batman and Superman in its top 4. Ranks 4-11 are backed by 3-7 people sources each, but the gaps are small: Wolverine 6.69, Captain America 7.38, Wonder Woman 8.07. The only US polls that name a full top 10 (OnePoll 2020, Wisevoter 2022) are older, and Wisevoter's method is unpublished. No YouGov Ratings category for superheroes or comic characters exists: I checked all 177 YouGov US ratings groups. Ranks 15-24 lean on Wikipedia pageviews, which are global and news-driven. Jean Grey (#16) and The Punisher (#18) rest on pageviews alone and could be swapped for Hawkeye or Green Arrow if they look odd. The Flash at #21 is lower than gut. Consulted but not scored: YouGov 2013 favorite comic character (open-ended; only the top 5 is published, unordered: Archie, Batman, Spider-Man, Superman ~10%, Wonder Woman); Wilson Research 2002 US voters (Superman 27, Spider-Man 15, Batman 14, Wonder Woman 11, Hulk 7), which is too old and pre-MCU; Morning Consult 2018 (partial: Spider-Man ~75% fav, Hulk 71, Captain America/Iron Man 69); YouGov Ratings MCU/DC/X-Men movie popularity (film titles, not characters).
